query: WITH ValidDates AS (SELECT YEAR(CAST(graduation_date AS DATE)) AS graduation_year FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala WHERE graduation_date IS NOT NULL AND university_classification_name = 'الجامعات الحكومية' ) SELECT graduation_year, COUNT(*) AS graduate_count FROM ValidDates GROUP BY graduation_year ORDER BY graduate_count DESC LIMIT 1
raw_question: ماهي أعلى سنة في عدد الخريجين لجميع الجامعات الحكومية؟
